requirements.text: Patients should be able to book, cancel, and reschedule their appointments online.
Patients should be able to request repeat prescriptions online.
Patients should have secure online access to their test results after clinician review.
The portal must reduce the workload on receptionists.
The portal should be accessible to elderly patients and those who are not tech-savvy.
Appointment booking interface must have a calendar view for available time slots.
Patients should be able to filter appointments by type and specific providers.
Patients should receive reminders about upcoming appointments via email or text.
The system should have a feature to flag urgent appointments for same-day consideration.
GPs and nurses should be able to manage their schedules and set availability in the backend.
The repeat prescription request process should include a simple form for patients to select medications.
Patients should be able to track the status of their prescription requests.
Safeguards must be in place to prevent patients from requesting unauthorized prescriptions.
The interface for handling prescription requests should be efficient for reception staff.
The test results access interface must be user-friendly and categorized by test type or date.
A robust identity verification process must be implemented for accessing test results.
Data must be encrypted both during transmission and storage.
Patients should have the option to ask questions about their test results through the portal.
The portal design must be straightforward and uncluttered for easy navigation.
Adjustable text sizes and contrast settings must be available for users with vision impairments.
A 'read aloud' feature should be included for users who prefer auditory information.
Tutorial resources such as videos or step-by-step guides must be provided for users.
A support line or chat feature must be available for users needing additional help.
The portal must comply with accessibility standards like WCAG 2.1 AA.
Integration with existing practice management software is crucial.
Automated reminders for upcoming appointments must be implemented, with patient preference for notification method.
